=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2296-3507 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge's merge paths never check the ledger for the unreachable security hold. RB_MERGE_ACTION is true for `merge`, `merge_with_followup` and a final-attempt `fix` (2296-2300). The only gate is `rb_security_merge_gate` at 2405, which never reads the ledger. The merges run at 2806-2807, 2921-2922 and 3503.
  WHY: A ledger with `STATUS: unreachable` and `UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true` can still be merged through `merge_with_followup` or a final-attempt `fix`, because the prompt text forbids only the literal `merge`. This breaks §1. Reviewers disagreed on severity (luna and glm said BLOCKER, sonnet said MAJOR, gemini gave none); the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1178-1583 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic-skip job's inline auto-merge path (`gh pr merge --auto`, AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND ... action=squash at ~1551) never reads REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH and never calls `review_unreachable_security_hold_active`.
  WHY: If a later trigger review-skips a PR that has a sticky unreachable security finding, auto-merge is enabled and the hold is bypassed. Reviewers disagreed on severity (luna said BLOCKER, sonnet and glm said MAJOR, gemini gave none); the highest is used. Gemini filed this under scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh but cited review_autofix.yml:1327 and ~1507-1583.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:150-155 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unreachable-security hold branch exits 0 without running `gh pr merge --disable-auto`, so auto-merge armed in an earlier round stays armed.
  WHY: scripts/review_head_gate.sh withdraws auto-merge only on `pull_request` synchronize events (82-95). On a workflow_dispatch or other non-synchronize run, the armed auto-merge still merges the PR once its checks pass. Reviewers disagreed on severity (minimax and luna said BLOCKER, glm said MAJOR, gemini gave none); the highest is used.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:151-155 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The hold suppresses the clean marker, the head-gate success status and auto-merge, then exits 0 without putting the PR into any terminal or blocked state. The hold is sticky.
  WHY: The review sweep re-dispatches PRs whose head is not approved (review_autofix_sweep.yml 259-266). Each tick runs a full round on the same unchanged head until the round cap adds `ai:needs-human`, which is the repeat-round loop #10057 sets out to stop.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1212-1378 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `review_unreachable_followup_sync`, a `gh issue create` that succeeds but whose URL cannot be parsed (outcome=orphan) leaves the ledger follow-up number unset. Entries stay pending, `_review_unreachable_rebuild_from_ledger` regenerates them, and the existing issue is never looked up by its marker.
  WHY: A later or resumed round runs `gh issue create` again and makes a duplicate follow-up issue, which breaks "one follow-up issue per PR". Reviewers disagreed on severity (minimax and glm said MAJOR, sonnet said NIT, gemini gave none); the highest is used. Gemini put the trigger at a failed ledger write rather than an unparsed URL.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1163-1397 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a same-head resume, `_review_unreachable_rebuild_from_ledger` does not rebuild `review_issues.pre_unreachable.txt`, and pending rows carry a placeholder block id. The body builder's `except OSError` swallows the missing file.
  WHY: A follow-up issue created or appended from a resumed round leaves out the reviewer text for each finding. Reviewers disagreed on severity (minimax and glm said MAJOR, sonnet said NIT); the highest is used. Minimax says the block id is empty, while sonnet and glm say it is "-".
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:138-155 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The hold gate exits 0 with only a warning or log line and emits no step-failing `::error::` signal.
  WHY: Operators get no observable signal that the hold is why auto-merge is off, or that auto-merge is still armed from an earlier round.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§1: a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh "Execute judge action" merge gating before `rb_security_merge_gate` (line 2405); merge paths 2806, 2921, 3503; scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh near line 296
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes only `render_review_rb_prior_round_decisions_file` (lines 703-832). No hunk adds a deterministic `UNREACHABLE_SECURITY: true` check before the judge's `gh pr merge` calls (lines 2405, 2806, 2921, 3503), and scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh is never touched. The only guard is prompt text that forbids the literal `merge`, which leaves `merge_with_followup` and a final-attempt `fix` (a merge at line 2299) unguarded.
- requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input and from the round's open-issue count."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh editor prompt assembly (embedding of reviewer_bundle.txt as the authoritative findings source) and the ledger filtering path
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The full reviewer_bundle.txt is still embedded unchanged as "the authoritative findings source" (lines 1778-1780), and lines 1797-1804 say advisory artifacts must not replace that signal. Unreachable blocks are stubbed only in the advisory review_issues.txt. `_review_unreachable_editor_scope_note` adds a "do not edit" note capped at 50 paths but removes nothing. No hunk changes the round's open-issue or approval count, and the editor deferred this itself (TASK_GAP_DEFERRED).
- requirement: The follow-up issue includes the reviewer text for each unreachable finding.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh `_review_unreachable_rebuild_from_ledger` and `review_unreachable_followup_sync`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The resume rebuild does not recreate review_issues.pre_unreachable.txt and writes "-" as the pending row's block ID (lines 1376-1378). The body builder silently accepts a missing pre-rewrite file (lines 1159-1175) and then has no block text to include (lines 1198-1206).
- requirement: "An unreachable security finding keeps the PR blocked" — the gate must be the single chokepoint, not one of several.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml deterministic-skip job (~1507-1583, `AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND ... action=squash` near 1550-1552) and scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff only adds the env var `REVIEW_UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ENABLED` to the job env block (lines 2103-2111). Neither the inline auto-merge path nor the security-pass script calls `review_unreachable_security_hold_active` or reads `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH`.
- requirement: "A failing CI check on the PR's own head is never treated as unreachable by this rule. Cancelled or timed-out CI jobs are not findings at all and must not be given to the editor as one."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh reviewer-context assembly (lines ~2587 and ~2663)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py emits `no_result[i]` blocks, and the editor prompt in review_apply_fixes.sh (lines 1746-1747) marks them as not findings. The reviewer context in scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh was not updated, so reviewers keep raising cancelled shards as findings.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 2296-2300 set `RB_MERGE_ACTION="true"` for `merge|merge_with_followup`, and for `fix` when `IS_FINAL=true`. The only merge gate after that is `rb_security_merge_gate` at line 2405. The merges happen at 2806-2807, 2921-2922 and 3503. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deterministic unreachable-security hold exists only in review_enable_auto_merge.sh (138-155). The judge's merge paths never read the ledger, and the prompt forbids only the literal `merge`.
  WHY: At max iterations, `merge_with_followup` or a final-attempt `fix` runs `gh pr merge` and merges the security finding, which breaks §1. The suggested fix is to run the awk ledger check before 2405 and skip with reason `security_hold_unreachable`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:the step "Mark PR review-skipped, mark linked issues ready-to-merge, enable auto-merge" (lines 1327-1580); gate at line 1330; AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND ... action=squash at line 1551 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The deterministic-skip merge path never consults `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` or `review_unreachable_security_hold_active`.
  WHY: A later deterministic skip authorizes labels and auto-merge without the ledger, which bypasses the hold.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:lines 151-155; scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh lines 472-477 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The hold suppresses the clean marker, the head-gate status and auto-merge, then exits 0 with no terminal or blocked state, and the hold is sticky.
  WHY: The sweep (review_autofix_sweep.yml 259-266) re-dispatches full rounds on the same head until the round cap adds `ai:needs-human`, which is the loop #10057 targets. The suggested fix is to add a needs-human or review-blocked label in the hold branch.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:`review_unreachable_followup_sync`, the create branch (empty `ru_followup` after `gh issue create` succeeds → `ru_outcome="orphan"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the URL cannot be parsed, nothing is recorded in the ledger and pending rows stay pending.
  WHY: The next round creates a second follow-up issue, which breaks "one follow-up issue per PR".
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:`_review_unreachable_rebuild_from_ledger` (`if (uf == "pending") print row "\t-" > new_out`); body builder `neutral(blocks.get(block_id, ""))` with `except OSError: pass` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On resume, rebuilt pending rows carry block id `-` and pre_unreachable.txt is not rebuilt.
  WHY: The follow-up body leaves out the reviewer text.

There is no deterministic check before lines 2806, 2921, 3503, and the prompt guard does not cover `merge_with_followup` or a final-attempt `fix`. | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
